es.inicio.title: Pescamapa: dónde, cuándo y con quién pescar en Argentina
es.inicio.description: La guía para pescar en toda la Argentina: dónde ir, cuándo, qué dice el reglamento y con qué guía local salir. Datos al día y la voz de quienes pescan ahí.
es.inicio.hero.mapa: Mapa de Argentina con los destinos de pesca de Pescamapa
es.inicio.eyebrow: El mapa para salir a pescar
es.inicio.copy: Del surubí en las islas del Paraná a la trucha en los Andes. Encontrá el destino que encaja con tu próxima salida.
es.inicio.destinos.p: Arrancamos por el Paraná correntino. Cada guía se publica cuando sus datos están verificados con fuentes oficiales.
es.inicio.nota: Las temporadas, especies habilitadas, tallas, cupos y modalidades dependen del ambiente y del reglamento vigente. Confirmá siempre con la autoridad local antes de salir.

es.inicio.prop3.p: Guías y alojamientos con información clara, publicados con su consentimiento y precios con fecha.

es.ficha.citas.h2: Lo que dicen los que pescan ahí
es.ficha.elegir.h3: Cómo elegir guía: qué preguntar antes de reservar
es.ficha.elegir.1: Modalidad: ¿trabaja con carnada, spinning/baitcasting o mosca? Elegí al que se especializa en lo que querés hacer.
es.ficha.elegir.2: Lancha y equipo: ¿qué lancha es, cuántos pescadores lleva, qué motor tiene (potencia, eléctrico de proa)? ¿Plataforma, sonda? ¿Presta equipos?
es.ficha.elegir.3: Qué incluye: carnada, comida, combustible, alojamiento, traslados. Pedilo por escrito, junto con el precio.
es.ficha.elegir.4: La fecha manda: los meses definen el tipo de pesca. Preguntá qué rinde en tu fecha, con qué altura y temperatura del agua.
es.ficha.elegir.5: El lugar: ubicación del alojamiento, bajada de lancha, distancia a las zonas de pesca y el ambiente en general.
es.ficha.elegir.6: Referencias: fotos de salidas recientes y pescadores que hayan ido. Si podés, hablá con el dueño o con quien opera.
es.ficha.elegir.fuente: Lo armamos con lo que nos contaron guías y operadores locales.
es.consulta.p: Contanos cuándo querés ir y qué querés pescar. Te respondemos con opciones de guías y alojamientos de %lugar%, sin costo.
es.consulta.privacidad: Usamos tus datos solo para responderte y para pasarle tu consulta a los prestadores que elijas.
es.consulta.ok: ¡Gracias! Recibimos tu consulta y te escribimos pronto.
es.consulta.error: No pudimos enviar la consulta. Revisá tu nombre y tu contacto, o probá más tarde.
es.inicio.prest.privacidad: Usamos tus datos solo para contactarte y armar tu ficha. No se publica nada sin tu permiso.

en.marca.lema: Where, when and who to fish with in Argentina.
en.marca.definicion: Pescamapa is the guide to fishing all over Argentina: where to go, when, what the rules say and which local guide to book, with current facts and the voices of the people who fish there.
en.pie.legal: Guidance only. Sport fishing is governed by provincial regulations, licences and the conditions of each water. Check with the competent authority and licensed outfitters before you travel.
en.borrador.texto: Some facts are still being verified; don’t use it to plan a trip yet.
en.inicio.title: Pescamapa: where, when and who to fish with in Argentina
en.inicio.description: The guide to fishing all over Argentina: where to go, when, what the rules say and which local guide to book. Current facts, told by the people who fish there.
en.inicio.hero.mapa: Map of Argentina with Pescamapa’s fishing destinations
en.inicio.tag1.h: What do you want to catch?
en.inicio.copy: From surubí among the Paraná islands to trout in the Andes. Find the destination that fits your next trip.
en.inicio.destinos.p: We start on the Paraná in Corrientes. Each guide is published once its facts are verified against official sources.
en.inicio.nota: Seasons, permitted species, size limits, bag limits and techniques depend on the water and the current regulations. Always confirm with the local authority before you go.
en.inicio.mapa.h2: A map to find your river.
en.inicio.mapa.p: Start with a region, then narrow it down by species, technique and the kind of trip you want.
en.inicio.prop.eyebrow: More than a list of places
en.inicio.prop.h2: Planning the trip should be part of the trip.
en.inicio.prop1.p: Compare regions, species and techniques to choose a trip that matches your experience and your dates.
en.inicio.prop2.p: Seasons, licences and access explained with a review date and a link to the official source.
en.inicio.prop3.p: Guides and lodging with clear information, published with their consent and dated prices.
en.inicio.prest.h2: Good local work deserves to be found.
en.inicio.prest.p: If you are a guide, run a lodge or organise fishing trips, join us: we survey each service, publish it with your consent and send you requests from anglers.

en.mapa.description: Interactive map of sport fishing destinations in Argentina: the Litoral, Patagonia, lagoons and the Atlantic coast. Tap a point to see species and the guide.
en.mapa.leyenda: Orange: published guides or guides in progress. Grey: upcoming destinations. Indicative map, not for navigation.
en.mapa.etiqueta: Map of fishing destinations in Argentina
en.mapa.sinjs: The map needs JavaScript. Destinations are listed on this same page.

en.ficha.cambian: Rules change: confirm with the authority before you go.
en.ficha.prestadores.p: Tell us what you are looking for and we will connect you with guides and lodging in %lugar%. We build listings from public information and correct them with each provider; prices, when shown, are dated.

en.creditos.description: Authors and licences of the photos used on Pescamapa. All come from Wikimedia Commons under free licences that allow use with attribution.
en.creditos.p: Pescamapa’s photos come from Wikimedia Commons and are used under their free licences. Thanks to their authors.
en.ficha.elegir.h3: How to choose a guide: what to ask before booking
en.ficha.elegir.1: Style: does the guide fish bait, spinning/baitcasting or fly? Pick one who specialises in what you want to do.
en.ficha.elegir.2: Boat and gear: what boat, how many anglers it takes, which engine (horsepower, bow electric motor)? Casting platform, fish finder? Is tackle provided?
en.ficha.elegir.3: What is included: bait, meals, fuel, lodging, transfers. Get it in writing, with the price.
en.ficha.elegir.4: Timing rules: the month decides the fishing. Ask what works on your dates, at what river level and water temperature.
en.ficha.elegir.5: The place: where the lodging is, boat ramp, distance to the fishing areas and the overall setting.
en.ficha.elegir.6: References: photos of recent trips and anglers who have been. If you can, talk to the owner or operator.
en.ficha.elegir.fuente: Put together from what local guides and operators told us.
en.consulta.p: Tell us when you want to go and what you want to catch. We will reply with guide and lodging options in %lugar%, free of charge.
en.consulta.privacidad: We only use your details to reply and to pass your request on to the outfitters you choose.
en.consulta.ok: Thanks! We got your request and will get back to you soon.
en.consulta.error: We could not send your request. Check your name and contact, or try again later.
en.inicio.prest.privacidad: We only use your details to contact you and build your listing. Nothing is published without your permission.
